nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf(address=>uint) tracking token balances.
Public nested mapping allowance(address=>address=>uint) for spending approvals.
Public constant decimals set to 18.
Public total token supply.
Public token name.
Public token symbol.
Private owner address used for privileged access control.
Internal constant Uniswap router address used in constructor allowance.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable returns(bool); forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable ensure(_from,_to) returns(bool); token transfer with ensure modifier.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable returns(bool); sets allowance for msg.sender.
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only delegatecall to arbitrary address.
batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) public payable returns(bool); owner-only batch transfer with unchecked multiplication.
ensure(address _from, address _to) modifier; restricts transfers to owner or computed pair address.
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure returns(address); computes Uniswap pair address.
constructor(string memory _name, string memory _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable public; initializes token state and owner.
msg.sender is caller-controlled and used for access control, ownership, and transfer logic.
Low-level delegatecall to arbitrary address parameter a in delegate().
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend can overflow.
Parameter a in delegate; arbitrary delegatecall target address.
Parameter b in delegate; calldata passed to delegatecall.
Parameter _tos in batchSend; recipient address array whose length is multiplied.
Parameter _value in batchSend; amount multiplied by recipient array length.
Local variable total in batchSend; result of unchecked multiplication.
Local variable UNI in ensure; computed pair address used in require.
